corridor_noticeboard.title: Noticeboard
corridor_noticeboard.speaker: protagonist
corridor_noticeboard.text: An evacuation plan squeezed up against a class photo. Three rows of faces in the photo. The plan has a red dot for you.
corridor_noticeboard.repeat_text: Someone in the bottom row blinked. The red dot is right next to his shoulder.

record.text: The evacuation plan is pinned beside a class photo on the corridor board.

corridor_extinguisher.title: Fire extinguisher
corridor_extinguisher.speaker: protagonist
corridor_extinguisher.text: A hole punched through the inspection tag. Tilt your head and a digit shows through, from the phone number on the wall.
corridor_extinguisher.repeat_text: Just the one digit. The tag covers the rest.

record.text: The extinguisher’s inspection tag covers part of a number written on the wall.

corridor_classroom_glass.title: Classroom window
corridor_classroom_glass.prompt: Jump to look through the glass
corridor_classroom_glass.speaker: protagonist
corridor_classroom_glass.text: On the way up you catch a few rows of desk legs. Then the sill cuts the whole room off again.
corridor_classroom_glass.repeat_text: This time you look for the board first. Your shoes come down before you find it.

record.text: A glimpse of rows of desks through the high window. Not enough to pick out my seat.

corridor_high_window.title: High classroom window
corridor_high_window.prompt: Jump to look through the high window
corridor_high_window.speaker: protagonist
corridor_high_window.text: A few empty desks through the slit. The last one’s further back than you expected. Then your feet are down again.

corridor_folded_directory.title: Building directory
corridor_folded_directory.speaker: protagonist
corridor_folded_directory.text: “01 →” on one side. “← 01” on the other. Both numbers again over the glass doors. There’s a narrow tab in a slot beneath the directory.

record.text: The glass entrance is marked 01 twice. On the directory the two 01s point in opposite directions.

archive_threshold.title: Punch marks
archive_threshold.speaker: protagonist
archive_threshold.text: The top strip is longer than its copy. The round registration holes are the same size. The brass slide is just under them.
archive_threshold.repeat_text: The top strip is longer than its copy. The round registration holes are the same size. The brass slide is just under them.

plan_room_threshold.title: Survey marks
plan_room_threshold.speaker: protagonist
plan_room_threshold.text: Two routes are drawn on the strip. One ends inside the stair. Only the one with the short elbow reaches the little square. There is a slide below.
plan_room_threshold.repeat_text: Two routes are drawn on the strip. One ends inside the stair. Only the one with the short elbow reaches the little square. There is a slide below.

projection_room_threshold.title: Frame marks
projection_room_threshold.speaker: protagonist
projection_room_threshold.text: Three frame outlines shrink towards different corners. Only the middle one has a nick at its lower edge. The slide carries the same nick.
projection_room_threshold.repeat_text: Three frame outlines shrink towards different corners. Only the middle one has a nick at its lower edge. The slide carries the same nick.

computer_room_threshold.title: Raster index
computer_room_threshold.speaker: protagonist
computer_room_threshold.text: The little plate has three broken rows. The lowest one continues on the frame, one notch to the right. The top two stop short.
computer_room_threshold.repeat_text: The little plate has three broken rows. The lowest one continues on the frame, one notch to the right. The top two stop short.

vacant_office_threshold.title: Carbon imprint
vacant_office_threshold.speaker: protagonist
vacant_office_threshold.text: A printed corner looks square but sits above its indentation. The lower impression is worn through. The slide has the same worn edge.
vacant_office_threshold.repeat_text: A printed corner looks square but sits above its indentation. The lower impression is worn through. The slide has the same worn edge.

principal_office_threshold.title: False centre
principal_office_threshold.speaker: protagonist
principal_office_threshold.text: The long stroke marks the centre of the plate. Two pinholes sit off to one side. The pin behind the slide is worn only there.
principal_office_threshold.repeat_text: The long stroke marks the centre of the plate. Two pinholes sit off to one side. The pin behind the slide is worn only there.

corridor_stair_screen.title: Stair shutter
corridor_stair_screen.speaker: protagonist
corridor_stair_screen.text: The shutter is still up. There’s another half-flight behind it, but the first step hangs beyond the rail.

corridor_bell_register.title: Bell register
corridor_bell_register.speaker: protagonist
corridor_bell_register.text: Two plates have lines on the other side. The last one is blank.
